                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Indian Chess Teams (both Men and Women) were crowned the National Team of the Year at the prestigious Sportstar Aces Awards 2025 held in Mumbai.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • This recognition was primarily due to their historic \"Double Gold\" achievement at the 45th FIDE Chess Olympiad held in Budapest, Hungary, in September 2024.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Men's team, comprising Gukesh D, R Praggnanandhaa, Arjun Erigaisi, Vidit Gujrathi, and Pentala Harikrishna, finished at the top of the open section with an almost perfect score.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The Women's team, consisting of Harika Dronavalli, R Vaishali, Divya Deshmukh, Vantika Agrawal, and Tania Sachdev, also secured the Gold Medal, marking the first time India won both categories simultaneously.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The performance solidified India's position as a global superpower in chess, with players like Gukesh D and Arjun Erigaisi also winning individual gold medals for their respective boards. Hence, the correct answer is Indian Chess Teams.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Sportstar Aces Awards: \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • It is an annual awards ceremony organized by The Hindu Group through its sports magazine, Sportstar.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The 2025 edition celebrated the sporting achievements of Indian athletes throughout the calendar year 2024, which included the Paris Olympics and Paralympics.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Other Major Winners in 2025:\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Sportstar of the Year (Male): Gukesh D was honored for his stellar year, which included winning the Candidates Tournament and leading the Olympiad team.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Sportstar of the Year (Female): Manu Bhaker received this award after becoming the first Indian in the post-Independence era to win two medals in a single edition of the Olympics (Paris 2024).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Sportsman of the Year (Track and Field): Neeraj Chopra was recognized for his Silver Medal at the Paris 2024 Olympics.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Significance of the 45th Chess Olympiad:\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • India joined an elite group of nations (including the former USSR and China) to have won the Double Gold at a single Olympiad.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The event saw Gukesh D achieve a staggering rating performance, further cementing his status as the youngest-ever challenger for the World Chess Championship.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Men's team, comprising Gukesh D, R Praggnanandhaa, Arjun Erigaisi, Vidit Gujrathi, and Pentala Harikrishna, finished at the top of the open section with an almost perfect score.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Women's team, consisting of Harika Dronavalli, R Vaishali, Divya Deshmukh, Vantika Agrawal, and Tania Sachdev, also secured the Gold Medal, marking the first time India won both categories simultaneously.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The performance solidified India's position as a global superpower in chess, with players like Gukesh D and Arjun Erigaisi also winning individual gold medals for their respective boards. Hence, the correct answer is Indian Chess Teams.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Sportstar Aces Awards: \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • It is an annual awards ceremony organized by The Hindu Group through its sports magazine, Sportstar.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The 2025 edition celebrated the sporting achievements of Indian athletes throughout the calendar year 2024, which included the Paris Olympics and Paralympics.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Other Major Winners in 2025:\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Sportstar of the Year (Male): Gukesh D was honored for his stellar year, which included winning the Candidates Tournament and leading the Olympiad team.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Sportstar of the Year (Female): Manu Bhaker received this award after becoming the first Indian in the post-Independence era to win two medals in a single edition of the Olympics (Paris 2024).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Sportsman of the Year (Track and Field): Neeraj Chopra was recognized for his Silver Medal at the Paris 2024 Olympics.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Significance of the 45th Chess Olympiad:\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • India joined an elite group of nations (including the former USSR and China) to have won the Double Gold at a single Olympiad.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The event saw Gukesh D achieve a staggering rating performance, further cementing his status as the youngest-ever challenger for the World Chess Championship.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Important Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Jaspal Rana, the personal coach of Manu Bhaker, was awarded the Coach of the Year for his contribution to India's success in Shooting.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Indian Men's Hockey Team (Option 1) was also a strong contender after winning the Bronze Medal at the Paris 2024 Olympics, but the unprecedented double gold in chess gave the Indian Chess Teams the edge.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The Lifetime Achievement Award at the 2025 ceremony was presented to shooting legend Abhinav Bindra, India's first individual Olympic gold medalist.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • These awards use a combination of jury votes (led by legends like Sunil Gavaskar) and public voting to determine winners across various categories.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \nसही उत्तर भारतीय शतरंज टीमें हैं।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • भारतीय शतरंज टीमों (पुरुष और महिला दोनों) को मुंबई में आयोजित प्रतिष्ठित स्पोर्टस्टार एसेस अवार्ड्स 2025 में 'नेशनल टीम ऑफ द ईयर' का ताज पहनाया गया।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • यह मान्यता मुख्य रूप से सितंबर 2024 में बुडापेस्ट, हंगरी में आयोजित 45वें फाइड (FIDE) शतरंज ओलंपियाड में उनकी ऐतिहासिक \"डबल गोल्ड\" उपलब्धि के कारण थी।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • पुरुष टीम, जिसमें गुकेश डी, आर प्रज्ञानंद, अर्जुन एरिगैसी, विदित गुजराती और पेंटाला हरिकृष्णा शामिल थे, ने लगभग पूर्ण स्कोर के साथ ओपन सेक्शन में शीर्ष स्थान हासिल किया।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • महिला टीम, जिसमें हरिका द्रोणावल्ली, आर वैशाली, दिव्या देशमुख, वंतिका अग्रवाल और तान्या सचदेव शामिल थीं, ने भी स्वर्ण पदक हासिल किया, यह पहली बार था जब भारत ने एक साथ दोनों श्रेणियों में जीत हासिल की।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • इस प्रदर्शन ने शतरंज में एक वैश्विक महाशक्ति के रूप में भारत की स्थिति को मजबूत किया, जिसमें गुकेश डी और अर्जुन एरिगैसी जैसे खिलाड़ियों ने अपने-अपने बोर्ड के लिए व्यक्तिगत स्वर्ण पदक भी जीते। अतः, सही उत्तर भारतीय शतरंज टीमें हैं।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • स्पोर्टस्टार एसेस अवार्ड्स: \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • यह द हिंदू ग्रुप द्वारा अपनी खेल पत्रिका, स्पोर्टस्टार के माध्यम से आयोजित एक वार्षिक पुरस्कार समारोह है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • 2025 संस्करण ने 2024 के कैलें", "te": "\n
